patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I switched to a new dish soap and now both my hands are red, dry, and so itchy. It's just where the soap touched — no fever, I feel totally fine otherwise.
clinical.presentationShort: 40yo F — bilateral hand erythema/scaling in a contact distribution after a new soap, no systemic symptoms — contact dermatitis.
clinical.presentationLong: 40-year-old female with bilateral hand erythema and scaling in a contact distribution after switching soaps, with no systemic symptoms — allergic contact dermatitis.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → avoid the trigger, topical steroid, emollients, antihistamine for itch; discharge.
diagnosis.why: Rash confined to contact areas + a new exposure = contact dermatitis. Avoid trigger + topical steroid.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, holding out both reddened hands
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: an asian 40-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: holding out both reddened, irritated hands. Expression: mildly bothered but well. Clearly visible: red, irritated skin on both hands. No text, no logos.
